items.title: Add a current-story declaration surface for generated artifacts
items.context: Extend the accepted checklist or verification evidence metadata so a story can declare generated delivery artifacts with path, reason, and related intent. Prefer a narrow story-local schema instead of global ignore rules.

items.title: Classify declared generated artifacts separately from unexpected dirty files
items.context: Integrate declarations with the dirty ownership classifier so declared artifacts appear as declared_artifact_changes and undeclared outputs like tests/output/... remain unexpected. This story should build on B-6326 rather than duplicating classifier logic.

items.title: Require evidence or delivery coverage for declared artifacts
items.context: DONE should not silently allow arbitrary generated files. Add validation that declared artifacts are referenced by verificationEvidence, delivery check, or summary so the generated output is tied to user-visible work.

items.title: Add regression coverage for the BL21 lacZ viewer output path
items.context: Use tests/output/bl21_lacz_ecoli_minicell/prodenovo_viewer.json as the field-derived example: undeclared it stays unexpected; declared with evidence it moves to declared artifact category.
